scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -n web,api,worker -c magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w @hive-cloud/web" "npm run dev -w @hive-cloud/api" "npm run dev -w @hive-cloud/worker"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @hive-cloud/contracts && npm run build -w @hive-cloud/security && npm run build -w @hive-cloud/database && npm run build -w @hive-cloud/router
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @hive-cloud/api && npm run build -w @hive-cloud/worker && npm run build -w @hive-cloud/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @hive-cloud/api && npm run typecheck -w @hive-cloud/worker && npm run typecheck -w @hive-cloud/web
scripts.test:auth:workspace: npm run build:packages && vitest run apps/web/src/auth.integration.test.ts apps/web/src/app/signin/signin-action.test.ts
scripts.preflight: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
